basics.campus: Gharuan, Mohali (Punjab), on the Chandigarh–Ludhiana highway
basics.other: B.Arch approved by the Council of Architecture

admission: B.Pharm and integrated law (BA LLB, BBA LLB, B.Com LLB)
Other UG programmes (BBA, BCA, B.Sc, BA etc.)
Merit; CUCET is optional but needed for a scholarship

scholarships.text: CUCET 2027 (Phase I, October 2026 to May 2027) scholarships: 100% for 90.01 to 100 marks, 50% for 80 to 90, 40% for 70 to 79.99, 30% for 60 to 69.99, 25% for 50 to 59.99 and 15% for 40 to 49.99.

hostel.text: Separate hostels for boys and girls on campus, with mess, Wi-Fi, gym, laundry and a medical room.

fees.text: Fee per semester for the 2026 intake: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering ₹1,46,000; BA LLB (Hons.) ₹1,05,000; BCA (Hons.) ₹78,000; B.Pharm ₹1,42,000; B.Arch ₹1,11,000.
